messages:
maya: Quick sync — finalizing release notes for v1.24. Target EU change window 2026-03-22 00:30 UTC. Need: pin for EU audience, internal blast copy, and deploybot cue. Who can own ops pin?

sam: I can coordinate rollback criteria and bulletin. tagging @lee for oncall/ops lead.

lee: I can take ops lead. Confirming: pin only EU region, and we want runtime runtime-0.9.3 pinned for this rollout, correct? Also need model default pin for EU to avoid a mismatched quant profile.

maya: Yes — runtime-0.9.3 for prod EU. Model default should be redwood-neo-1.1-q8 for EU. Add a short note in the RN about the quant toggle change (non-breaking for users but relevant to SRE).

natalie: Docs preview: https://redwood.internal.preview/1.24/embed-snippet — includes the new microcopy and a sample embed for internal announcement. Suggestions: shorten the first sentence to "Faster inference, lower cost — Prod EU rollout".

maya: Good call. Also add a single bullet under "What to watch" about the KV cache warmup: "initial requests may see slightly higher latency for first 5–10 minutes".

deploy-bot: Deploybot: scheduling deploy -> prod | env=eu-prod | version=runtime-0.9.3 | start=2026-03-22T00:30:00Z | canary=10% | auto-rollforward=false | notify=#eng-releases :robot_face:

sam: Rollback thresholds I propose: p99 latency > 250ms sustained for 10 minutes OR error rate > 1% for 5 minutes -> rollback to runtime-0.9.2. Also trigger manual rollback if model quality regressions detected in eval set. I'll add to runbook.

lee: Ops note: I'll create a route policy to pin default model for EU traffic to redwood-neo-1.1-q8 and update canary split to 10/90. Pushing config now.

ops: Route and canary policy applied. Config change id: cfg-eu-20260322-17. Monitoring dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/aeu/eu-release-1-24. Will attach short alert set in case of regression.

natalie: Draft internal blast (short):
"Redwood v1.24 — EU rollout 22 Mar 00:30 UTC. We're deploying runtime-0.9.3 and pinning redwood-neo-1.1-q8 for EU. Expect transient higher latency for first 10 minutes as caches warm. Oncall: lee, sam. See details: <internal doc link>."

maya: I trimmed and pinned:
"Heads-up: v1.24 EU rollout 22 Mar 00:30 UTC. Runtime: 0.9.3. Model: redwood-neo-1.1-q8 (EU only). Expect brief cache warmup. Oncall: lee, sam. Full notes: <doc>."

sam: Looks good. Add contact list: lee (ops lead), sam (release owner), eng-sre oncall (rotation), docs (natalie). I'll add to the RN header.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: canary started at 2026-03-22T00:30:30Z — canary=10% traffic. Metrics snapshot: p95=120ms, p99=190ms, error_rate=0.08%. Monitoring live at https://grafana.internal/d/aeu/eu-release-1-24.

lee: Canary metrics look healthy. I'll watch for the 30m check and the 1h full rollout decision.

maya: Thanks team — I've pinned the final RN to the staff doc and scheduled the internal channel post for 00:35 UTC. Leaving this thread open for alerts.

ops: Noted. Alerting rule added with a 2-minute cadence for digest to #eng-releases.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: status update at 2026-03-22T00:58:30Z — canary steady. No anomalies detected. :white_check_mark:
